fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name this server advertises. Must resolve to this server’s public IP.

listen_address.description: IP address to bind to. Use '127.0.0.1' for loopback-only, or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

port.description: NNTP service port. Standard unencrypted NNTP port is 119.

nntps_enabled.description: Enable NNTPS (NNTP over TLS/SSL) service on a dedicated port.

nntps_port.description: Port for NNTPS (NNTP over TLS). Standard port is 563.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

max_articles.description: Maximum number of articles to retain per newsgroup (0 = keep all).

max_age.description: Maximum age of articles in days (0 = keep forever). Older articles are expired.

spool_directory.description: Directory where NNTP articles and metadata are stored.

config_directory.description: Directory for configuration files (e.g., active, newsgroups).

interactive.description: Enable interactive mode (used for batch article imports or maintenance tasks).

server.description: Enable serving of articles to clients (required for NNTP server mode).

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output to syslog.

peers.description: List of upstream NNTP peers to fetch articles from.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the upstream NNTP server.

port.description: Port of the upstream NNTP server (default 119).

username.description: Optional authentication username for the peer.

password.description: Optional authentication password for the peer (stored in plain text).

groups.description: Optional list of specific newsgroups to subscribe to from this peer.

allow_read.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR subnets allowed to read articles (subscribe, fetch, etc.).

allow_post.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR subnets allowed to post articles to this server.

default_group.description: Optional default group to auto-subscribe new users to (e.g., 'news.announce.misc').

posting_enabled.description: Enable posting of new articles from local or remote clients.

post_filter.description: Path to an external command/script that processes each article before storage (e.g., spam filter or moderation hook).

lockfile.description: Path to the lockfile used to prevent concurrent processes.

listgroups.description: Enable listing of all available newsgroups (LISTGROUPS command). Disable if exposing group names is a concern.

xover.description: Enable XOVER support (required for modern NNTP clients like Thunderbird).

max_article_size.description: Maximum article size in bytes (0 = unlimited). Default: 1 MiB.

localgroups_config.description: Path to a localgroups file (e.g., '/etc/leafnode/localgroups') that defines local-only newsgroups.

capabilities.description: Enable RFC 3977 capability advertisement (e.g., STARTTLS, MODE-READER).

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS support for NNTPS or STARTTLS (requires certificate and key).

tls_cert_path.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format).

tls_key_path.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format, unencrypted).
